channel.title: CBT Cards updates
channel.description: Reviewed CBT Cards website, public-data, research, localization and agent-interface updates.

item.title: Reviewed practice, agent evaluation, and trust hardening
item.description: Consolidated the situation-first reviewed practice system, source/audit/freshness boundaries, semantic model-evaluation pipeline, performance/privacy/localization/search hardening, explicit rights provenance, and current Agent Skill v1.8.0 into one verified public project state.

item.title: Toolkit review and publication overlay
item.description: Added an explicit CBT Cards-owned review layer that separates raw toolkit source records from records reviewed for standalone website publication.

item.title: Versioned public JSON Schema contracts
item.description: Published JSON Schema 2020-12 contracts for CBT Cards-owned machine-readable resources and made them discoverable from the public catalog.

item.title: Localization review and generated publication pipeline
item.description: Completed Russian machine-draft coverage for the current curated knowledge set, added a human-readable language-status hub, and introduced deterministic generation that publishes only human-reviewed localized records.

item.title: Knowledge, worksheets, agent data, and discovery foundation
item.description: Expanded the standalone CBT Cards website from a product landing page into a public knowledge and discovery surface for people, search engines, and read-only AI/RAG clients.

item.title: Indexed-page crawl graph quality gate
item.description: Added homepage links to key public resource hubs and a CI check that rejects orphaned or excessively deep indexable pages.

item.title: Reproducible agent eval baselines and citation metadata
item.description: Added a versioned evaluation-run format, two deterministic non-model baselines tied to the exact evaluation dataset hash, CI regeneration checks, and repository-level citation metadata.

item.title: Provenance-first model-run protocol v1
item.description: Added a two-stage protocol for generating real assistant responses without benchmark answers and scoring routing metadata afterward with a deterministic evaluator.

item.title: Locale registry and translation overlay foundation
item.description: Added a source-locale registry, versioned translation-record contract, Russian pilot translation overlays, and CI rules that keep localized review and publication status separate from source content.

item.title: Held-out paraphrase and adversarial eval challenge
item.description: Added 12 separately authored challenge cases and recorded the unchanged deterministic router's large drop from its friendly starter-set score.

item.title: Public agent routing and boundary evals
item.description: Published a starter set of 24 evaluation cases for testing CBT Cards resource routing, localization status, publication boundaries, privacy boundaries, and safety abstention without prescribing exact model wording.

item.title: Public reflection resource skill v1.5.0
item.description: Reframed the CBT Cards agent skill around finding and using public reflection cards, worksheets, learning resources, and verified project information rather than treating the mobile app as the primary resource surface.

item.title: Portable Agent Skills release v1.7.0
item.description: Published a strict portable Agent Skills profile for the latest CBT Cards skill while preserving the existing immutable URL convention and adding installation guidance for OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and generic Agent Skills clients.

item.title: Localization-aware agent skill v1.6.0
item.description: Added explicit language and translation-status handling to the CBT Cards agent skill so assistants can distinguish source content, machine drafts, reviewed translations, and published localized resources.

item.title: Standalone CBT Cards website
item.description: Established the standalone CBT Cards public website on the cbt-cards.github.io domain with canonical product, privacy, terms, support, FAQ, and feature documentation.
